raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the NFL game between Eagles and Jaguars, scheduled for October 11 at 9:30 AM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Eagles and Jaguars combine to score 6 or more points in the first quarter.

If the combined first quarter total is less than 6, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
